sources.title: Mystique Germanium Fuzz & Boost (Limited Edition) | CopperSound Pedals
sources.excerpt: Official product page identifies the exact pedal as a limited 10th-anniversary edition, 50 units, with a fully discrete germanium fuzz, independent germanium boost, switchable boost order, two-band EQ, and hand-measured germanium transistors.
